newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Rights group challenges Manila APEC ban in court.
newsitem.headline: Rights group challenges Manila APEC ban in court.

text.p: Philippine human rights groups petitioned the Supreme Court on Thursday seeking to lift a ban on the entry of Nobel Peace Prize winner and East Timorese resistance leader Jose Ramos-Horta.
The petition said the Philippine ban on Horta's entry, for a visit scheduled to coincide with next month's APEC summit, was illegal.

The petition was filed by the Manila People's Forum, a coalition of non-governmental organisations (NGOs), and named Foreign Secretary Domingo Siazon and Immigration Commissioner Edgar Mendoza as respondents.

Manila banned Horta after he had accepted an invitation to address an international NGO conference to be held in parallel with the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum ministerial meeting and leaders' summit from November 22-25.
The government said Horta's presence could disrupt the APEC meeting.
